summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Quick Start Tutorial ## Introduction to the Interface Open Marvelous Designer, and we can see five main windows. The one on the left is our **Library Window**. Here, you can quickly access frequently used files. - Click the **Add** button to add a frequently used folder for easy access. - Double-click to open the clothing file. - After selecting a folder, click the name again to rename the folder. - Quickly double-click the folder name to open the folder. - Double-click to open the virtual model. ## History Record Window There is a **History Record Window** on the side: - Single-click to open it. - Click the **Add** button to add a history record. - After selecting a history record, click the name again to rename it. - Quickly double-click the history record to read it. - After reading the history record, you can go back to the location of the record and delete the current record. ## Modular Configurator At the bottom left is the **Modular Configurator**. Here you can use various clothing items from the library as needed and freely mix and match: - Open the folder and select the clothing you need. - At the bottom window, you will see that the clothing is divided into several parts, which you can combine according to your requirements. ## 3D Window Overview This is the **3D Window**, where you can simulate clothing and make adjustments. ### Display Settings On the left side of the 3D window, there is a vertical **Map Menu** used to adjust the display settings of the 3D window: - Click on the icons to see all available options, such as displaying clothing elements. - You can also adjust the display style of the model. ## 2D Window Functionality In the **2D Window** next to it, you can edit and adjust the clothing version. ## Object Window The window on the upper right is the **Object Window**: - Here, you can see all materials for the clothing, such as buttons and the back of the eyes. - When selecting a material in the Object Window, corresponding attributes will appear in the **Property Editor** at the bottom. ### Property Editor In the **Property Editor**, you can adjust properties according to your needs. ## Modes in Marvelous Designer ### Simulation Mode The upper right corner allows you to switch modes: - **Simulation Mode**: Used to simulate the clothing. - **Animation Mode**: Used to create fashion animations. After entering the action file, you can simulate and record the fashion animation. - **Module Mode**: Here, you can edit, adjust, and save the fashion module to create various clothing designs. - **UV Editor Mode**: Adjust the UV layout of the clothing. - **Carving Mode**: Use various brushes to carve the clothing. For example, use the smooth tool and click and drag the mouse on the clothing to make the folds smooth. ### Window Display Options Back in the Simulation Mode, the lower right corner allows you to change the window display options: - You can select all windows or single windows according to your needs. ```
